lines.text: Eleazar stood his ground against the Philistines at Pas-dammim until his hand stuck to his sword.
Shammah took his stand in the middle of a lentil field, and struck down the Philistines.
David longed for water from the well near Hebron, and three mighty men broke through to get it.
Abishai, the brother of Joab, wielded his spear against six hundred men and killed them.
Benaiah killed a lion in a pit on a snowy day, and David appointed him over his guard.
